notes.title: Bugfix And Update 09/09
notes.content:
1. fixed a bug that caused a crash when using the PS5 Controller

2. added way to play OFFLINE ONLY worlds with friends only.

　The host should move the cursor to the OFFLINE ONLY world on the world selection screen, hold down the Z and C keys (or the L and R buttons on the gamepad), and press the decision key.

　OFFLINE ONLY worlds are very unsuitable for online play. There is one aspect of the game that is severe on lag and difficult to play without conversation.Only those who can tolerate it should try to play with friends.After all this time, only those who can tolerate it should try to play with friends.

3. added a special debugging option
　Right-click PICO PARK on the Steam Client and select "Properties".
　You can set the following two types of LAUNCH OPTIONS in GENERAL.

　+disable_remote_input 
　  (Force disable TecoGamePad) 
　+perf_check
       (Display performance information on the screen)

notes.title: Bugfix 07/25
notes.content:
Update
- Support TecoGamePad for local play mode.  ( An app that uses a mobile phone as a controller )
- RTT is displayed in the upper left corner to visualize the network speed.

Bugfix
- Fixed a bug that the game would not display properly when using Intel Graphics HD.
- Fixed a bug that it does not start on some PCs.
- Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when entering the goal with a block in 11-3.
- Fixed a bug that Thunder was not displayed correctly.
- Changed default setting from FullScreen to Windows mode.
- In local multiplayer mode, the up key on the 2P keyboard can be used to rotate 8-1 blocks.
